title: agent_ui: Track existing permissions when registering threads
body:
Discover permission requests that are already pending when a thread is registered with a conversation. Previously, registration only subscribed to future authorization events, so a waiting tool call could exist in the thread but remain absent from the conversation's pending-request lookup and subagent permission counts.

- Seed tracking from existing `WaitingForConfirmation` tool calls in entry order.
- Use the same deduplicating insertion path for initial state and subsequent request events, preserving already-tracked order.
- Leave authorization-received removal, conversation-wide shortcut policy, and preview interaction unchanged.

Not really an issue in practice for the zed agent, but will be potentially for ACP v2

Release Notes:

- N/A
